criteria.text: Patients can book only free slots; booking a taken slot raises SlotTaken.
Slots are 20 minutes long and start on the hour or at :20 and :40.
No slots are offered on public holidays or on the provider's leave days.
Cancelling more than 24 hours before is free; later cancellations cost a 25 EUR fee.
A cancelled slot becomes free again and is offered to the first patient on the waitlist.
Reminder messages are sent 24 hours before the appointment.
Patients receive no reminder for an appointment they cancelled.
A patient cannot hold more than 2 future appointments with one provider; past appointments do not count.
Online booking closes 2 hours before a slot starts.
Fees are shown in EUR with two decimals.

T01.name: test_taken_slot_raises
T01.code:
def test_taken_slot_raises(service):
    service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "09:20"))

    with pytest.raises(SlotTaken):
        service.book("pat-2", "p1", at(TUE, "09:20"))

    assert len(service.appointments) == 1

T02.name: test_earliest_free_skips_taken
T02.code:
def test_earliest_free_skips_taken(service):
    service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "09:00"))
    service.book("pat-2", "p1", at(TUE, "09:20"))

    slot = earliest_free(service, "p1", TUE)

    assert slot.start == at(TUE, "09:40")

T03.name: test_book_free_slot
T03.code:
def test_book_free_slot(service):
    appt = service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "09:20"))

    assert appt.status == "booked"
    assert appt.start == at(TUE, "09:20")
    assert at(TUE, "09:20") not in [s.start for s in service.free_slots("p1", TUE)]
assertions: assert at(TUE, "09:20") not in [s.start for s in service.free_slots("p1", TUE)]

T10.name: test_cancelled_booking_frees_a_place
T10.code:
def test_cancelled_booking_frees_a_place(service):
    first = service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "09:00"))
    service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(WED, "09:00"))
    cancel(service, first)

    third = service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(THU, "09:00"))

    assert third.status == "booked"

T11.name: test_fee_by_notice
T11.code:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("hours_before, fee", [(48, 0), (25, 0)])
def test_fee_by_notice(service, clock, hours_before, fee):
    appt = service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(THU, "10:00"))
    clock.set(appt.start - timedelta(hours=hours_before))

    charged = cancel(service, appt)

    assert charged == fee
    assert appt.fee == fee

def test_sent_notice_not_sent_again(service, notifier, outbox):
    service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "11:00"))

    notifier.send_due(at(TUE, "11:00"))

T15.name: test_outbox_records_messages
T15.code:
def test_outbox_records_messages():
    outbox = Outbox()

    outbox.send("pat-1", "reminder", {"start": "x"})
    outbox.send("pat-2", "slot offer")

    assert [m.kind for m in outbox.messages] == ["reminder", "slot offer"]
    assert len(outbox.of_kind("reminder")) == 1
    assert outbox.messages[1].data == {}
    assert outbox.messages[0].to == "pat-1"
assertions: assert [m.kind for m in outbox.messages] == ["reminder", "slot offer"]

def test_new_booking_has_no_fee(service):

T20.name: test_free_slots_skip_booked_ones
T20.code:
def test_free_slots_skip_booked_ones(service):
    service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "09:20"))

    free = [s.start for s in service.free_slots("p1", TUE)]

    assert at(TUE, "09:20") not in free
    assert at(TUE, "09:00") in free
    assert len(free) == 8

    other_provider = service.free_slots("p2", TUE)

    assert len(other_provider) == 9

T21.name: test_booking_stores_appointment
T21.code:
def test_booking_stores_appointment(service):
    appt = service.book("pat-1", "p2", at(WED, "15:40"))

    assert service.appointments == [appt]
    assert appt.end == at(WED, "16:00")
    assert appt.provider_id == "p2"
    assert appt.patient_id == "pat-1"
    assert service.for_patient("pat-1") == [appt]

T23.code:
def test_two_bookings_allowed(service):
    first = service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(TUE, "09:00"))
    second = service.book("pat-1", "p1", at(WED, "10:20"))
